# Create Blog Covers and Illustrations with AI

Turn article text into faithful covers, explanatory diagrams, and editable sharing images with AI.

[Start this course on AILesson](https://ailesson.io/courses/create-blog-covers-and-illustrations-with-ai)

An article can be clear in words and still be difficult to picture. A cover needs one recognizable idea; an in-article diagram needs the relationships that make the explanation work; a sharing image needs text you can still change tomorrow.

Here you will practise all three tasks with a supplied article. Ask AI to translate the text into a visual, compare the actual result with the source, and decide what can be saved. You will work with a generated cover and editable diagram and sharing layouts, each with a downloadable source and a worksheet for your own article.

The Lessons are self-contained. Follow the suggested order or choose the type of image you need. You do not need to finish one image to start another. The common skill is keeping the article's meaning intact while changing its form.

## Frequently asked questions

### Do I need a finished article or design experience?

No. Each Lesson supplies the same complete practice article and explains which parts matter for its task. The article is synthetic teaching material, not a real team's report. For your own work, start with an approved article whose claims you can check.

### Do I need an image generator during the Lesson?

No. The guided practice shows recorded requests and actual saved outputs. To repeat the work outside the Course, use an AI tool that can generate images for the cover, or create editable SVG files for the diagram and sharing image. SVG is an image format that can retain editable shapes and text; use a compatible vector editor to change those files.

### Are the images ready to publish anywhere?

You can save the provided examples, but Course completion does not upload or publish anything. Check your own text, image rights, final size, and destination preview before use. The sharing-image dimensions are a project choice, not a promise about a platform's requirements. No click or engagement improvement is claimed.
